items.title: Grease
items.line: Grease opened on 16 June 1978. Made for $6 million, it was the highest-grossing film of the year, with $132.5 million on its first US run.

items.title: Space Invaders
items.line: Taito put Tomohiro Nishikado's Space Invaders into Japanese arcades in July 1978. Over 100,000 machines were installed in Japan by the end of the year.

items.title: Louise Brown
items.line: Louise Brown, the first baby born through IVF, arrived at Oldham General Hospital on 25 July 1978. Robert Edwards got the Nobel Prize for the work in 2010.

items.title: Animal House
items.line: National Lampoon's Animal House opened on 28 July 1978. It cost $3 million and grossed $120.1 million in the US and Canada on its first release.

items.title: Camp David Accords
items.line: Carter hosted Sadat and Begin at Camp David from 5 to 17 September 1978. The two leaders shared that year's Nobel Peace Prize.
